senses.gloss: f. h. (v. preced.) travelling implements tied up, bundle.—Pl. כְּפָתוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100">Gen. R. s. 100</cite> <he>קשרי כְּפָתוֹתֵיהֶן התירו</he> (some ed. <he>קשרות</he>) they (the Canaanites) untied the knots of their (the pall-bearers’) bundles (assisted them in their preparations for camping); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 161:6">Yalk. Gen. 161</cite> <he>בתרי כתפותיהם</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:10:2">Y. Sot. I, 17ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>קשרי כתפיהן</he> (corr. acc.).
